cards.answer: Dr. Mundo is a health-scaling tank fighter who uses bonesaw slows to approach and empowered attacks to pressure enemies, with magic and physical damage. His immobilization resistance and healing help him stay in fights.
cards.counterplay: Use distance and cover against bonesaws, contest dropped canisters when safe, and disengage during his ultimate.

cards.answer: Goes Where He Pleases periodically blocks the next hostile immobilizing effect, costing Mundo health and dropping a canister. Collecting it heals him and reduces the passive's cooldown; enemy champions can destroy it by approaching it. He also has increased health regeneration.
cards.counterplay: Account for his immobilization resistance before committing crowd control, and contest the canister when safe.

cards.answer: Infected Bonesaw hits the first enemy in its path, dealing magic damage based on their current health and slowing them. A hit refunds part of Mundo's health cost, with a full refund against champions or monsters.
cards.counterplay: Dodge sideways or use minions as cover, and avoid letting the slow set up his approach.

cards.answer: Heart Zapper deals ongoing magic damage around Mundo and stores part of the damage he takes as grey health. Recasting or reaching the end detonates it for nearby magic damage and restores part of that grey health, with greater healing if the burst hits a champion or large monster.
cards.counterplay: Avoid committing burst damage into the charge, and move away before the detonation.

cards.answer: Blunt Force Trauma passively grants attack damage based on Mundo's maximum health. Its active empowers his next basic attack with bonus physical damage that increases with his missing health. A killed target or a small monster is flung away, damaging enemies in its path.
cards.counterplay: Respect his empowered attack when he is wounded, and avoid lining up behind targets he can fling.
